:::{#exm-iff}
#### "If and only if" with equal and different truth values

Take $x = 4$.

- "$x$ is [even](number-systems.qmd#def-even-odd) $\Leftrightarrow x > 3$" is true:
  $4$ is even and $4 > 3$, so both sides are true.
- "$x > 3 \Leftrightarrow x > 5$" is false:
  $4 > 3$ is true, but $4 > 5$ is false.

:::
